canonical_claim: For n at least 2, a finite nonzero Borel measure mu on the unit sphere in Euclidean n-space that has zero first moment and is not concentrated on any great subsphere is the surface-area measure of a convex body K with nonempty interior; K is unique up to translation. Conversely, every such surface-area measure has those properties.
